entries.title: Socket.IO Real-Time Data Hook
entries.why: The 3D dashboard needs real-time sensor data without polling. Socket.IO provides bidirectional WebSocket communication with automatic reconnection and fallback to polling.
entries.whatItDoes: Imports socket.io-client for WebSocket connection, Zustand store actions for state updates, and transient state mutators for high-frequency data. The hook manages the entire socket lifecycle.

entries.title: Hook State & Zustand Selectors
entries.why: The hook needs references for socket instance and reconnection tracking, plus Zustand actions for updating UI state when connection status changes.
entries.whatItDoes: useRef for socket instance (persists across renders) and reconnect counter. Selects Zustand actions: setConnected, setConnectionError, setLastUpdate, addAlert, setSystemStatus.

entries.title: Rig Telemetry Handler (10 Hz)
entries.why: Telemetry arrives at 10 Hz (100ms intervals). Using React state would cause 10 re-renders per second per rig. Instead, we mutate TRANSIENT state directly, avoiding React overhead.
entries.whatItDoes: Extracts machine_id and sensor values from event data. Validates machine_id is A/B/C. Calls updateTransientRig() to directly mutate transient state object. Updates lastUpdate timestamp (throttled to 1 Hz in UI).

failureModes.recovery: Data for unknown machines is dropped

entries.perfNotes: Direct mutation = O(1), no React reconciliation

entries.title: Anomaly Alert Handler
entries.why: Unlike telemetry, anomaly alerts are LOW frequency but HIGH importance. They SHOULD trigger React re-renders to show alert notifications immediately.
entries.whatItDoes: Creates alert object with: type, severity (critical if score > 0.8), machine_id, message, score, contributing sensors, detection method. Calls addAlert() to update Zustand state (triggers HUD re-render). Also updates transient state's anomalyScore.
entries.perfNotes: Re-render on anomaly is intentional - need to show alert UI

entries.title: Ketchup Factory Event Handlers
entries.why: The ketchup factory has different sensors (fill_level, viscosity, sauce_temp) and 25 production lines instead of 3 rigs. Separate handlers process these different event structures.
entries.whatItDoes: handleKetchupTelemetry: Extracts line_id (L01-L25) and ketchup-specific sensors, updates transient state via updateKetchupLine(). handleKetchupAnomalyAlert: Similar to rig alerts but includes anomaly_type (overfill, underfill, viscosity_fault).
entries.perfNotes: 25 lines * 10 Hz = 250 updates/sec, direct mutation handles this

entries.title: Socket Connection & Event Binding
entries.why: useEffect initializes the socket connection once on mount. It configures transports, reconnection behavior, and binds all event handlers. Cleanup disconnects on unmount.
entries.whatItDoes: Creates socket.io connection to localhost:5000 with: WebSocket + polling transports, 10 reconnection attempts, 1-5 second reconnection delay, 10 second timeout. Binds handlers for: connect, disconnect, connect_error, rig_telemetry, anomaly_alert, system_status, ketchup_telemetry, ketchup_anomaly_alert.

failureModes.recovery: After 10 failures, shows error in HUD

entries.perfNotes: WebSocket preferred, polling fallback for restrictive networks

entries.title: Machine Subscription on Connect
entries.why: The backend may support filtering which machines a client receives data for. Emitting 'subscribe_machines' tells the server this client wants data for rigs A, B, C.
entries.whatItDoes: On successful connection, emits 'subscribe_machines' event with { machines: ['A', 'B', 'C'] }. Server responds with 'machines_subscribed' confirmation.

entries.title: Cleanup & useSocketEmit Hook
entries.why: React's useEffect cleanup prevents memory leaks and duplicate event handlers. useSocketEmit provides a way to send events back to the server (e.g., acknowledge alerts).
entries.whatItDoes: Cleanup: Removes all event listeners with socket.off(), then disconnects. useSocketEmit: Returns emit() function that sends events to server if connected. Useful for bidirectional communication.
